items.title: China AI Spotlight · Cambricon — the chain behind the 500,000-unit target
items.summary: Third-quarter revenue rose 104% to a record, and nine-month profit already beats all of 2025. Yet operating cash flow was negative and inventory stands at CNY 11.66bn. Here is how Cambricon's growth and its bottlenecks hang on the same chain.

items.title: China AI Daily Report · November 20
items.summary: Shanghai fell 1.23% and the STAR Composite 5.23%, with 5,236 names down as semis and lithography equipment sold off. SMIC was the only riser in our eleven, up 2.63% and 17.87% over four sessions, while banks and dividend names lifted the SSE 50 to +0.45% late in the day.

items.title: US Markets Spotlight · AMD — a record quarter, and a 7.72% drop in a day
items.summary: Revenue of $13.38bn, data center of $8.5bn (+97%), guidance of $17bn — AMD accelerated. The stock fell 7.72% anyway, on a Hunterbrook short report aimed not at the results but at 22.4% of revenue billed in China and Hong Kong, a tenth from Singapore, and the Chinese partner that finishes most of its chips.

items.title: US Markets Daily Report · November 20
items.summary: Anthropic rose 17% in its debut and the market went the other way. The S&P 500 fell 2.03% for a sixth straight loss, the Dow closed below 50,000 for the first time since June, and AMD lost 7.72% on a short-seller report. The VIX jumped 17.6% to 28.90 and futures now price a December hike at 95%.

items.title: China AI Spotlight · Hygon (688041) — three things a 17% intraday fall left behind
items.summary: Hygon was pushed to CNY 156.05 intraday by a Samsung foundry audit rumour and closed back at CNY 180.00 (−4.81%). A look at the domestic compute axis that owns both an x86 CPU and a DCU — through its numbers, share and competitive position.

items.summary: With Shanghai down 0.28%, STAR 50 rose 1.83% to 1,270.78 on its own. New BIS export controls taking effect and a 'Samsung foundry audit' rumour drove intraday volatility.

items.title: US Markets Spotlight · NVDA — the quarter was won, the stock closed at its 52-week low
items.summary: Revenue of $115.8bn, data center of $107.6bn, guidance of about $130bn — every number beat. The stock still fell 2.89% to sit on its 52-week low. What stands between the results and the price is CEO succession and China rules.

items.title: US Markets Daily Report · November 19
items.summary: A fifth straight decline for the S&P 500 (-0.23%) while the Nasdaq added 0.42%. Nvidia fell 2.89% on a beat-and-raise, the Dow lost 1.11% as UnitedHealth sank 10.2%, and the Fed minutes plus Anthropic's record IPO set the tone.
